standard_prerequisites.name: The family of unions of a horizontal and a vertical strip
standard_prerequisites.statement: The family A plus consists of the hypergraphs on a finite vertex set in the plane whose edges are the intersections of the vertex set with the union of one horizontal and one vertical axis-parallel strip; the author's own definition is retained at source lines 234-235.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the family whose threshold the counted theorem bounds from both sides.

standard_prerequisites.name: Polychromatic colourings and the parameter m_H(k)
standard_prerequisites.statement: A polychromatic k-colouring colours the vertices so that every edge meets all k colour classes, and m_H(k) is the smallest threshold m such that every member of the family admits such a colouring after deleting the edges of size below m; retained at source lines 120 and 128-129.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted theorem brackets this parameter for the family of unions of two perpendicular strips.

standard_prerequisites.name: The cited upper bound for the family of axis-parallel strips
standard_prerequisites.statement: The proof of the upper bound appeals to a theorem of Aloupis, Cardinal, Collette, Imahori, Korman, Langerman, Schwartz, Smorodinsky and Taslakian stating that any point set in the plane can be coloured so that all axis-parallel strips of size at least two k minus one are polychromatic; that entry is cited in the proof and is supplied with this card as a fragment of the bibtex-formatted entry.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the only external result used, and it is what makes the upper bound immediate: an edge of size at least four k minus three contains a strip of size at least two k minus one.

core_obligations: Upper bound: colour an arbitrary point set so that every axis-parallel strip of size at least two k minus one is polychromatic, which the cited theorem provides, and note that every edge of size at least four k minus three contains a horizontal or a vertical strip of size at least two k minus one, hence is polychromatic (source line 597).

Lower bound: take eight sets H_1 to H_8 of the ceiling of three quarters of k minus one points each, arranged so that their abscissae are ordered as one to eight while their ordinates follow the order seven, five, eight, six, three, one, four, two, as displayed in the figure (source lines 599-607).

In any colouring of these vertices, each of the eight sets misses strictly more than k quarters of the colours, so the pigeonhole principle gives three of the sets sharing one missing colour (source line 675).

Observe that any three of the eight sets can be separated from the remaining five by the union of a horizontal and a vertical strip; the set of those separated points together with the three sets sharing a missing colour is then an edge of size three times the ceiling of three quarters of k minus one that is not polychromatic, which gives the lower bound (source line 675).

proof_roadmap.step: Upper bound by the cited colouring of the strip family.
Place the eight sets and read off their coordinate order from the figure.
Count missing colours, apply the pigeonhole principle, separate three sets by a cross and conclude.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2307.12154v3 的 Theorem kereszt（源 243-245 行，证明 595-676 行）：对由一条水平条带与一条竖直条带之并诱导的族给出 3⌈3k/4⌉−2 ≤ m_A+(k) ≤ 4k−3。关键操作不是例行核验：上界要把外部定理（条带族的多色染色）与「4k−3 点的大边必含一条 ≥2k−1 点的条带」这一几何观察接起来（597 行）；下界要设计八个各 ⌈3k/4⌉−1 点的集合，并把它们的横纵坐标排成两条互不相同的链（横坐标递增 1..8，纵坐标顺序 7,5,8,6,3,1,4,2），使得**任意三个集合都能被一条水平条带与一条竖直条带的并与其他五个分离**（599-607 行 + 图）；再由「每个集合至少缺严格多于 k/4 种颜色」+ 鸽笼得三个集合共享同一缺色（675 行）。难点在于坐标链的设计必须同时保证分离性与三集合共享缺色的计数；原文位置在证明的 597、599-607 与 675 行。
